Deployment troubleshooting and rollback
CV confirms NGINX/WinSCP hosting support, not particular shell commands or rollback procedure.
I would diagnose deployment issues by checking the HTTP status, application logs, web server
configuration and upstream connectivity. Before configuration changes I would follow approval and
rollback procedures. These are general practices unless confirmed in my actual work.
